name: app-dark-budget-app-with-lime-gradient-header-and-goal-bars
title: Dark Budget App with Pastel Gradient Header
whatItIs: Two dark phones on a grey gradient: a home with a pastel yellow-lilac gradient header, a black balance card, add expense, income and view transaction tiles and a bar chart of categories; and a savings goals screen with gradient progress bars.
whatItMeans: A soft pastel gradient header lifts an otherwise dark app, and the same gradient fills the progress bars for unity.
techniques: Pastel gradient as the header and progress fill
Two phones side by side at different heights
bestFor: Dark UI with a gradient accent

vocabulary.definition: A top area filled with a colour blend.
A progress bar for a savings target.
A tile with an icon and label for a quick action.
